text:
Claire H.: Heads up, staging build failed after the docs migration. Linkcheck error shows both a broken fragment and a missing diagram.

CI Bot: build #1287 failed at step: linkcheck - https://ci.redwood/1287 :x:

Claire H.: Logs: 
```
ERROR Broken fragment: /reference/embeddings.md#how-it-works -> fragment not found
ERROR Missing asset: /static/img/embedding-flow.svg -> 404
```

Ravi: I saw this pattern after the mdx conversion. Docusaurus slugify behavior changed some headings (spaces -> dashes, punctuation stripped). The old link targeted `#how-it-works` but the new anchor is likely `#how-it-works-for-embeddings` or similar.

Jordan M.: I can run a quick grep across the repo: `rg "embeddings.md#how-it-works" --hidden docs/`

Priya S.: Found 4 references: examples/python/embeddings_quickstart.py, guides/migration-notes.md, tutorials/embed-ops.md, and a comment in the SDK README.

Claire H.: The missing svg is odd. It used to be under `assets/diagrams/embedding-flow.svg`. During the move we put it into `static/img/embedding-flow.svg` but the reference in the MDX uses a relative path `../assets/diagrams/embedding-flow.svg`. That no longer resolves in the new layout.

Ravi: Plan: 1) fix fragments by updating refs to the new slugs 2) fix image paths to use site-root style `/img/embedding-flow.svg` or import images in MDX with relative imports 3) add a regression test for changed fragments on PRs that touch headings.

Jordan M.: Preference: update refs + adjust the example snippets in the python example. Also add a short anchor-friendly id on the target heading to keep old external links working, e.g., `## How it works for embeddings {#how-it-works}`. That buys backwards compatibility.

Priya S.: I'll open a small PR that does the four ref updates + change the python example link `#how-it-works` -> `#how-it-works-for-embeddings` and add the explicit id on the target.

Claire H.: Sounds good. When you open the PR, please run `pnpm docs:build && pnpm docs:linkcheck` locally. Also run `python -m http.server` to sanity-check static paths if needed.

Priya S.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834 - includes: updated refs, explicit heading id on reference/embeddings.md, fixed image path to `/img/embedding-flow.svg`, and updated examples/python/embeddings_quickstart.py link. Added a tiny unit test that checks fragment presence for changed files.

CI Bot: PR 834 - linkcheck step queued.

Ravi: Nice. One thought: instead of always adding explicit ids we should add a note in migration-notes.md about heading slug differences between MkDocs and Docusaurus so contributors know to check fragments.

Jordan M.: Agreed. Add a short section: "Heading slug differences" with sample before/after.

Priya S.: Added the migration note in the same PR and included a short script `scripts/check-fragments.sh` used in the test.

CI Bot: PR 834 - all checks passed :white_check_mark: Linkcheck now green.

Claire H.: Merged. Staging build succeeded after the merge. Thanks everyone.

Ravi: Filing an infra ticket to add a lightweight pre-commit hook that runs fragment checks for files changed in a PR - saves a roundtrip.

Jordan M.: Also logging a follow-up to canonicalize image locations under `/static/img` in the docs contributor guide.

Claire H.: Closing thread. :tada:
